note: v1, written: UNDER THE NOISE. Hard industrial techno at 134 bpm in F minor (the style board's t7 row), built on auditory continuity: a sound cut out and replaced by a loud noise burst is still heard, because the brain fills in what the noise could have hidden. THE PHANTOM KICK: through the build the kick is taken away beat by beat (beat four, then two and four, then three, then all four) and each missing kick becomes a slammed noise burst, so the four-on-the-floor keeps thumping in the ear with no kick in it; the drop puts it back. NEVER STOPS: a reese on F1 plays only the on-beat eighths, and every off-beat eighth is a burst, so the cut bass is heard as one drone and the bursts double as the off-beat hat. SEVEN: chirper-two's c2-clank (borrowed) on every seventh 16th. 909 kick into a pumped rumble bus, the distorted kh layered at the peak, claps in B and C. Form: intro 16, A 32, build 16, B 32, break 8, C 32, outro 16 - 4:32. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 95.395/93.235/95.644/95.171 (rms -13.2, crest 7.2, rhythm 100).
